- **Purple_Seed_Stain**: Shows plump seeds with purple/pink stain from hilum — not matching shriveled seeds in test.
- **White_Mold**: Shows white cottony mycelium on pods — not visible in test image.
- **Bean_Pod_Mottle_virus**: Shows heavy black seed coat mottling/pigment diffusion — seeds in test are more shriveled than mottled.
- **Downy_mildew**: Would show whitish crusty interior fungal mass — not visible in test image.

The test image shows the characteristic Phomopsis pattern: opened pods revealing shriveled/small seeds, with the classic mixed appearance of one partially normal seed alongside shriveled, darkened seeds — exactly matching the Phomopsis reference collage.
